name: zone-interface
description: Zone interfaces insert contact-like behavior between zone faces or between zones and other objects. They require creation commands plus interface-node properties for stiffness and strength.

notes: Choose stiffness high enough to limit penetration but not so high that the timestep becomes unnecessarily small.
Set tensile strength deliberately; zero tension is common for opening joints.
Residual values take over after the bond breaks; displacement-zero-dilation controls when dilation vanishes.
Use bonded-slip to set whether the interface allows slip while still bonded; shear-bond-ratio scales bonded shear resistance.
Check interface node count and groups immediately after creation.
Verify normal direction and selected faces before assigning properties.
For coupled flow, set and inspect permeability behavior explicitly.

Commands, not properties: permeability: Set via 'zone interface permeability <value>' command (interface-level, not a node property keyword).; stress-normal / stress-shear: Read-only node STATE — query via 'zone interface <id> node list stress' or via 'zone interface node ?' subcommands (NOT property keywords).; gap: Not a documented interface node property in FLAC2D 9.0.

'zone interface node list' alone is incomplete — must reference a specific interface first ('zone interface <id|name> node list <sub-kw>') with one of: displacement / extra / host / information / property / state / stress / target / velocity.
verification: Top level subcommands (10): create, create-from-3dec, effective, element, group, list, name, node, permeability, tolerance-contact
Node subcommands (11): displacement-shear, displacement-small, extra, group, history, initialize-stresses, list, property, stress-normal-increment, stress-shear, update
All 12 node property keywords documented in property_groups were acceptance-verified on a live interface (engine confirms each: 'Property <X> set in 16 interface nodes').
Negative claims confirmed: 'gap' and 'permeability' are rejected as node property keywords ('Unused extra parameter'); permeability is the interface-level command as documented.
'zone interface <name> node list' sub-keywords are an exact match with this file's list: displacement / extra / host / information / property / state / stress / target / velocity.
The property-name slot is not keyword-enumerated ('Unused extra parameter' on a bogus name) — probe by acceptance.
9.7 top-level extras not previously documented here: create-from-3dec, element, name.

examples.command:
zone face skin
zone face group 'Fault' range position-x 0.5 0.5
zone interface create by-face range group 'Fault'
zone interface node property stiffness-normal 1e9 stiffness-shear 5e8 cohesion 1e4 friction 30 tension 0

zone interface list
zone interface 1 node list information
zone interface 1 node list stress
